G4144.definition: πλόος, πλούς genitive, -όου, -oῦ (and in late writers also πλοός, like νοός from νοῦς), ὁ ; (πλέω),  ; a voyage: Act.21:7 27:9-10.†; (AS)

G4174.definition: (πολιτεύω),  ; 1. citizenship: Act.22:28 (3 Mac, ll. with, Hdt., Xen., a1.). ; 2. government, administration (Aristoph., Dem., al.). ; 3. a commonwealth: Eph.2:12.†; (AS)

G4176.definition: πολιτεύω more frequently as depon., -ομαι, and so in LXX and NT ; (πολίτης),  ; to be a citizen, live as a citizen: metaphorically, of conduct as based on heavenly citizenship, Act.23:1, Php.1:27.†; (AS)

G4152.definition: (πνεῦμα), ; 1. of or caused by the wind, air or breath (Arist., al.). ; 2. spiritual (opposite to σωματικός, Plut.); (a) of created beings : τὰ π. (RV, the spiritual hosts), Eph.6:12; of that which is related to the human spirit, opposite to ψυχικός, 1Co.15:44 15:46; (b) of that which belongs to or is actuated by the Divine Spirit; α of persons : 1Co.2:15 3:1 14:37, Gal.6:1; οἶκος π., figuratively, 1Pe.2:5; β of…

G4161.definition: (ποιέω),  ; that which is made or done, a work: Rom.1:20, Eph.2:10.†; (AS)

G4121.definition: (πλέον),  ; I. Intrans. ; 1. Of persons; (a) to abound in (Arist.); (b) to superabound: 2Co.8:15 (LXX). ; 2. Of things, to abound, superabound: Rom.5:20 6:1, 2Co.4:15, Php.4:17, 2Th.1:3, 2Pe.1:8. ; II. Trans. (Num.26:54, Psa.71:21; not cl, see Lft., Notes, 48 f.), to make to abound: 1Th.3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-πλεονάζω).†; SYN.: περισσεύω, q.v (AS)

G4110.definition: (πλάσσω),  ; that which is moulded or formed : Rom.9:20 (LXX).†; (AS)

G4148.definition: (πλοῦτος),  ; to make rich, enrich: with accusative of person(s), pass., 2Co.9:11. Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), 2Co.6:10; before ἐν, pass., 1Co.1:5.†; (AS)

G4153.definition: adv. (πνεῦμα), ; spiritually; (a) by the aid of the Holy Spirit: 1Co.2:13 (WH, mg.), 1Co.2:14; (b) in a spiritual sense : Rev.11:8.†; (AS)

G4123.definition: (πλέον, ἔχω),  ; = ὁ θέλων πλέον ἔχειν (see MM, xx), ; one desirous of having more, covetous: 1Co.5:10-11 6:10 Eph.5:5.†; (AS)

G4188.definition: (πίνω), ; late form of Att.. πῶμα,; drink: 1Co.10:4, Heb.9:10.†; (AS)

G4122.definition: (πλεονέκτης, which see),  ; 1. intrans., to have more, to have an advantage (cl., with genitive of person(s)). ; 2. Trans., in late writers (see M, Pr., 65), to over­reach, defraud: with accusative of person(s), 2Co.7:2 12:17-18; ἐν τ. πράγματιι, 1Th.4:6 (see M, Th., in l); pass., 2Co.2:11 (as also in cl.; see LS, see word).†; (AS)

G4109.definition: anything flat and broad. ; 1. a plain (poët.). ; 2. In late writers (Luc., al.), a flat stone, a tablet: 2Co.3:3, Heb.9:4.†; (AS)

G4182.definition: πολυ-ποίκιλος, -ον ; 1. much variegated, of greatly differing colours (Eur.). ; 2. manifold: Eph.3:10.†; (AS)

G4114.definition: breadth: Eph.3:18, Rev.21:16; τ. π. τῆς γῆς (Hab.1:6, מֶרְחָב), Rev.20:9.†; (AS)

G4175.definition: (πολιτεύω),  ; 1. an act of administration. ; 2. a form of government. ; 3. = πολιτεία, ; (a) citizenship : Php.3:20 (R, txt.); (b) community, commonwealth : Phi, l.with (R, mg.; for exx, see MM, xx).†; (AS)

G4136.definition: (πληροφορέω), ; full assurance, confidence: 1Th.1:5; τ. συνέσεως, Col.2:2; τ. ἐλπίδος, Heb.6:11; πίστεως, Heb.10:22 (cf. Lft. on Col., l.with; M, Th., 9).†; (AS)

G4140.definition: (πίμπλημι),  ; a filling up, satiety: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but ICC, in l, for the full satisfaction of the flesh, op. cit., 276 ff.), Col.2:23.†; (AS)

G4192.definition: 1. labour, toil: Col.4:13 ; 2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): Rev.16:10-11 21:4.†; SYN.: see: κόπος (AS)

G4117.definition: (πλέκω),  ; what is woven or twisted (as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. 1Pe.3:3) : pl., 1Ti.2:9.†; (AS)

G4131.definition: (πλήσσω),  ; a striker, brawler: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7 (Arist., Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4104.definition: (πιστός),  ; to make trustworthy (Thuc., 3Ki.1:36), hence, to establish (1Ch.17:14). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: with accusative of thing(s), 2Ti.3:14.†; (AS)

G4181.definition: adv. (πολύς, μέρος), ; in many parts or portions: Heb.1:1 (Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4187.definition: adv. (πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold ),  ; in many ways or manners: Heb.1:1 (Philo).†; (AS)

G4162.definition: (ποιέω)  ; 1. a making (Hdt., Thuc., al.). ; 2. a doing (Sir.19:18 51:19): Jas.1:25.†; (AS)

G4170.definition: (πόλεμος),  ; to make war, fight: Rev.12:7 b Rev.19:11; before μετά (2Ki.21:15 and see M, Pr., 106, 247), Rev.2:16 12:7 a Rev.13:4 17:14; hyperb., of private quarrels, Jas.4:2.†; (AS)

G4112.definition: (πλάσσω), ; 1. formed, moulded (Hes., Plat., al.). ; 2. Metaphorical, made up, fabricated, feigned (Hdt., Xen., al.): 2Pe.2:3.†; (AS)

G4107.definition: (πλανάω),  ; = πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, Ju 13 (WH, mg., -τες).†; (AS)

G4158.definition: (πούς),  ; reaching to the feet. of a garment (sc. χιτών, cf. Ex, Ez, ll. with; Xen., al.), Rev.1:13 (for -η, LT7 read -ην; see M, Pr., 49).†; SYN.: στολή, see Tr., Syn., § 1 (AS)

G4141.definition: to strike, smite: pass., Rev.8:12 (cf. ἐπι, πλήσσω).†; (AS)
